planning_notes: Button D2 uses INPUT_PULLUP; hardware active-low means model value should be true when the button is pressed. Long-press and button release do not toggle state; only the press edge toggles run/stop state (logic handled in SysML).

Initial condition: system starts in STOP mode and LED D13 is off; upon start, LED toggles every 500ms; on stop, LED turns off immediately and the 500ms timing restarts when started again (all timing/business logic handled in SysML).
A time input is REQUIRED by the time-dependent behavior; the application should register elapsedMilliseconds automatically when absent.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Start/stop button (INPUT_PULLUP); model true when pressed (active-low hardware)

interfaces.name: elapsedMilliseconds
interfaces.meaning: Actual elapsed time since previous model step; first delta is zero
